checks.name: Recovery runs on native HTTP and writable IndexedDB
Previous-pack recovery is visible before any edit or storage write
Blocked synthetic edit and keyboard save leave the source and publication unchanged
Source export contains the exact recovery record and its extra fields
Equal filenames do not guess model or motion associations
Canceling and closing keep the exact previous-pack recovery
Portable Director import waits for recovery and cannot overwrite its source
Late read from the closed Director cannot unlock the next dialog
Only the current read reveals its recovery decision
Read failure leaves editing protected and offers a retry
Read retry recovers the untouched source
Library V5 exporter retains previous-pack recovery and all referenced media
pulsepack foreign recovery reaches review without writing
pulsepack foreign recovery copy keeps owner, provenance, phases and source
pulsepack same recovery reaches review without writing
pulsepack same recovery copy keeps owner, provenance, phases and source
pulsepack absent recovery reaches review without writing
pulsepack absent recovery copy keeps owner, provenance, phases and source
pulsebundle foreign recovery reaches review without writing
pulsebundle foreign recovery copy keeps owner, provenance, phases and source
pulsebundle same recovery reaches review without writing
pulsebundle same recovery copy keeps owner, provenance, phases and source
pulsebundle absent recovery reaches review without writing
pulsebundle absent recovery copy keeps owner, provenance, phases and source
pulsepack rejects unknown schema before media read, decode or write
pulsepack rejects phase hidden as schema 19 before media read, decode or write
pulsebundle rejects unknown schema before media read, decode or write
pulsebundle rejects phase hidden as schema 19 before media read, decode or write
Read-only refusal keeps source, edit guard and published scene unchanged
Native abort after put success preserves the previous recovery and cache
Retry commits reassociation and unlocks editing without publishing
Same-pack resume keeps source metadata and writes nothing until editing
First edit autosaves with schema 20 phases and source metadata preserved
Publication commits the scene and applied tombstone while keeping charts
Applied tombstone never resurrects an already published recovery
Unknown stored Director version is protected and cannot be normalized or reassociated
Unknown-version source export preserves every field exactly
Closing unsupported recovery does not modify its source
Native abort also preserves unsupported recovery after explicit discard fails
Explicit discard retry commits its tombstone and preserves the published song
Full browser reopen preserves the published song and explicit discard marker
Full browser reopen keeps every archive copy, phase and provenance
Restored old-pack recovery remains visible and protected after a full reopen
Integrated build stays unchanged during the native recovery test
No unhandled browser exception in the recovery lifecycle

scope: Native localhost Chromium/IndexedDB, real V27 MMD fixtures, protected previous-pack Director recovery, explicit reassociation and discard, refused writes and native transaction abort, schema boundaries, both library archive formats, and full browser close/reopen. Does not certify the full V22–V29 historical migration matrix, actual quota/eviction, OS crash, Safari or physical devices.
